text: 10月14日，北京市委书记尹力会见美国沃尔玛公司全球总裁兼首席执行官约翰·弗纳。尹力说，近年来，我们加快建设国际消费中心城市，不断优化商贸资源空间布局，出台一刻钟便民生活圈、超市业态提质升级、现代商贸流通体系建设等专项政策，为各类零售企业发展创造良好环境。
text_en: On October 14, Beijing Municipal Party Committee Secretary Yin Li met with Walmart Inc. President and CEO John Furner. Yin Li said that in recent years we have accelerated the building of an international consumption center city, continuously optimized the spatial layout of commercial resources, and introduced special policies such as the 15-minute convenient living circle, the upgrading of supermarket formats, and the construction of a modern commercial circulation system, creating a favorable environment for the development of retail enterprises of all kinds.
